record_scope_reconstruction: Mang Wein is the freight gate in Muse opposite Jiegao/Kyalgaung and must be distinguished from Nantaw and Sin Phyu pedestrian gates and Kyinsankyawt outside Muse. Targeted fresh Muse maps do not identify which unnamed road alignment is Mang Wein; generic Muse/Ruili centroid would be misleading.

source_checks.finding: AFP quotes rice-exchange official: six trucks at Mang Wein, with other goods routed via Kyinsankyawt.
Contemporary itinerary distinguishes Mang Wein–Jiegao, Kyin San Kyawt–Mantman, Kyu Koke–Wangding, Nantaw and Sin Phyu.
